title: a sidecar with no `aether_abi` tag is now rejected at the manifest-bypassing host loader
why: The host loader used to check the ABI tag only when it was present,
accepting a sidecar with no ABI tag at all — the softest ABI check among
all the loaders. Its C++ counterpart requires the tag to be present (even
an empty ABI tag is rejected): a memory-layout mismatch must never be
inferred leniently. Python's separate device-loading path also already
required the tag; this host loader was the one outlier.
The host loader now calls the same ABI-check function every other loader
in both languages uses, instead of its own separate check; this fixture
Only the host loader is exercised: the shared validator does not check the
ABI tag at all, since that check is specific to each loader rather than
part of the shared structural checks.
